main_text.l: minum lemnifcatum præconem illius oc-
ulos conuerteris, ne hoc quidem magnæ sap-
ientiæ (si qua est) videtur esse, quòd suis con-
trouerfiis de salute atque doctrina veritatis
ac fidei, quæ hoc noftro seculo in Ecclesia
Christi ventilari & excuti solent, ausus est li-
bros suos interiungere de translatione Impe-
Fecerat quidem prior Illyricus, in Ge-
rmanico illo Imperio degens, de ea re
scriptum certa quadam occasione oblata, vt
Germaniam suam, ac potius nostram, de ra-
tione ortus & iuris totius Imperii illius in-
formaret: atque hoc facto suo de gente Pon-
tificiorum nonnullos excitauerat, qui acu
leos illius {Greek}χρυσοπλόκῳ φωνῆς{/Greek} [?] (vt Erinna Les-
bia vocabat olim) occuparent, & in arenam
istam à diuino Theologiæ scammate quàm
remotissimam irruerent. Nec verò plané
improbare velim, si qui contra sentiunt, vt
cum ratione loco suo, tempore, & modo in
medium adferant sententiam suam: id enim
iuris naturalis est, & à nemine honestè legiti-
meque præscribi potest.
Sed quod prior seorsim fecit Illyricus, &
Bellarminus quoque seorsim posteà oppug-
nauit, id posteà inseri in harum disputatio-

page.notes: The left strip holds only show-through from the facing page and is not transcribed. The last line is cut off at the bottom of this part and continues on the next part. Word "interiungere" and "Pontificiorum" read as printed; "Fecerat" initial F is a plain capital. The Greek words are only partly legible in the scan, so the Greek reading is uncertain. The faint fragments at the left edge are not transcribed. Long s has been normalised to s and u/v, i/j to the modern convention as instructed.
